mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyperglycemia may antagonize sitagliptin's glycemic control, and loop diuretics increase risk of acute kidney injury affecting sitagliptin clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium), and glucose control regularly; adjust sitagliptin dosing if eGFR declines below 50 mL/min/1.73m².
